title: Fine-Tuning Methods — Teach the Generalist a Specific Job
key_insight: Fine-tuning continues training on selected input-output pairs. Small weight changes make the demonstrated responses more likely.
body:
## Teach the Generalist a Specific Job

A general model can discuss medicine but does not reliably write the clinic’s required note format. Examples can demonstrate the desired behavior.

Fine-tuning continues training on selected input-output pairs. Small weight changes make the demonstrated responses more likely.

Use it for learned behavior, not constantly changing facts. Retrieval is usually easier to update when knowledge changes weekly.
common_mistakes: Fine-tuning changes behavior without any examples.
Every input token should always be treated as the desired assistant output.
A preference dataset represents universal values automatically.
mini_exercise: Draw “Teach the Generalist a Specific Job” as three labeled steps, then explain what changes at each step.
real_world_usage: Fine-tuning can shape format, domain behavior, and task skill when prompting or retrieval is insufficient.
explain_back_prompt: Using “Teach the Generalist a Specific Job,” explain Fine-Tuning Methods without assuming the listener knows modern AI.
